description: Donations to ce-net build an open source factory and help people launch products on the network. Donors and users vote in Trana on what the money builds. Lists the open fund proposals, most votes first, each with who it helps and the count so far. Vote for one with trana_vote (id, choice yes; a reason is optional). People vote at https://trana.app/fund/ and donate at https://ce-net.com/support/.
name: trana_fund
title: ce-net fund: what donations build next
